turns.text: Hello. I want to return order SC-5214. The email is kaelis.draganut@example.com.
I’m sorry, but the 14-day return window for order SC-5214 has closed. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, so I can’t file a return request for this order.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: It was delivered earlier this month. The colour is not what I expected.

I’m sorry the colour wasn’t what you expected. Order SC-5214 was delivered on 4 November. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and that window has closed, so I can’t file a return request.
I can pay the postage. Please file the return anyway.
I’m sorry, but paying the return postage doesn’t extend the 14-day return window. That window has closed for order SC-5214, so I can’t file the return.
